body:
This was one of the many times I decided to take any sort of substance.
However I was anticipating this day as I had been told 2c-b was more amazing than anything I've ever tried.
As a raver, I've taken every letter from A-Z (Aside from Herion and Opium, the effects I've heard of aren't really that desirable to me.) So as you can imagine, it wasn't going to be anything new, just drop and dance, or so I thought.
I decided to meet with my friend LostLucidity for an event we call in my country J-Day.  It is held on Bob Marley's birthday and its the only day marijuana is legal to smoke, so we arrive in droves and smoke copius amounts.
After I finished work, LostLucidity and I travelled over to the city to meet with my supplier
we aptly dub 'TheTripper'
We smoked a fair amount of marijuana, the 2c-b was passed on and LostLucidity and I decided to head off on our own way.
We arrived at our friend Ice's house, he greeted us and we made our way to another house to drink. We started drinking and before long I was fairly drunk as was LostLucidity. (Now I'm not sure if our innebriated state had anything to do with the effects 2c-b had on me, but I couldn't say for sure.)
We left the house for the rave and once we arrived, I purchased an energy drink, poured two glasses, placed the powdered 2c-b in each glass and drank my fill.
I never noticed the effects starting visually, all that happened was I began feeling extremely happy, in love with practically every girl that passed me.
Then roughly half an hour later an explosion triggered in my brain, I began to feel the music and my eyes lit up with colour, every colour was defined and saturated, but it seemed to meld with any colour next to it, as if the entire rave was just different shades all warped into some twisted rainbow.
Next came my favourite effect, I stepped outside for a cigarette (strictly tobacco this time) and lit it up, I was perplexed at the way the flame danced away from the lighter, it seemed a metre away instead of just above my hand, it flickered around me in strange patterns, I managed to bring it under control and light my ciggie.
As soon as I stopped concentrating, I saw Ice, he walked up to me and said 'Is my hand alright? I can hardly see it.' (he had taken LSD, MDMA, and I had managed to give him some Coke that I had on me at the time).  But I could see it, in fact I saw millions of it, as he moved it it was followed by shadows of itself. The butterfly effect had taken control, soon everywhere I looked all I could see were shadows of people following them around.  Content with my trip, I left him unanswered and headed back inside to dance. This continued for another 6 hours (8 hours total trip time, not including half hour kick in time).  Until I lightly sailed off it and was left in a perfect state as if I had never been on it at all.
I look forward to my next time. I look forward to it quite a lot actually.
Happy tripping.
LiquidSky.
